surprising_details.description: What this participant reveals about this population that you didn't know. What contradicts, nuances, or expands what you believed. Must integrate the new finding with accumulated context. If there is no real novelty, respond exactly: 'No changes from the previous version.' If the segments do not contain sufficient information to evaluate this dimension, respond: 'Insufficient evidence in this document.'

language_patterns.description: How this participant speaks: metaphors used, euphemisms, filler words, repeated words, invented terms. Compare with the documented general pattern. If no difference: 'No changes from the previous version.' If insufficient text to evaluate: 'Insufficient evidence in this document.'

data_production_context.description: What you observe about how this document was produced: physical setting, participant attitude, power dynamics, avoided topics. If no new observations: 'No changes from the previous version.' If the text contains no clues about the production context: 'Insufficient evidence in this document.'

needs_retry.description: true if you consider your output is incomplete, low quality, or requires additional refinement

retry_reason.description: ONLY if needs_retry=true. CONCRETE and ACTIONABLE instruction on what to improve in the next attempt. E.g.: 'Label too generic — specify distinctive properties', 'Missing evidence from segment 47', 'Definition mixes two different concepts — separate'

suggested_action.description: Recommended action: proceed (output correct, continue), retry (retry with feedback), escalate_to_hitl (human decision needed), skip (skip this agent, not relevant), abort (unrecoverable error, stop everything)
